name: Nadia Okonkwo
bio: Nadia has edited the Ledger since it relaunched as a nonprofit in 2019. Before that she spent twelve years at regional dailies on the Gulf and Atlantic coasts.

name: Ben Castellano
bio: Ben has covered every council meeting since 2021 and reads the budget so you don't have to. Tips welcome, especially the boring ones.

name: Priya Raman
beat: The waterfront, storms, sea level rise
bio: Priya covers the port, the fleet and how Port Merrow is preparing for higher water. She grew up two streets from the seawall.

name: Marcus Hale
bio: Marcus writes about who is hiring, who is closing and what it costs to live here. He previously covered shipping for a trade weekly.

name: June Whitaker
bio: June covers the Port Merrow Unified School District, from board meetings to bus routes. She is a former middle school science teacher.

name: Diego Ferreira
beat: High school and minor league sports
bio: Diego has called Gulls games from the press box for nine seasons and keeps the only complete box scores for Merrow High football since 1988.

name: Lena Sorensen
bio: Lena writes about the people who make Port Merrow interesting after dark. She has eaten at every chowder stand on the boardwalk, twice.

name: Ledger Editorial Board
bio: The editorial board is Nadia Okonkwo, opinion editor Samuel Reyes and two community members who serve one-year terms. Editorials are separate from our news reporting.
